en: Maki!
...I knew you would come here.

If you're reinvestigating old areas, you'd
have to come here eventually.

But...before you do, listen to what I
have to say.

Is this about the blueprints?
Have you looked through all of them?

Yeah I have, but something caught my eye
that worried me.
Although, I'm not sure how significant it is.

Hey, Himiko, did you find anything
in Rantaro's room?

I'm not gonna tell you! Stop asking me!
Shut up! Leave me alone!
Huh? Why?

If I say I didn't find anything, you're gonna
decide I'm useless, aren't you...?
I-I won't let that happen...
So...I guess she didn't find anything.

Don't worry. I wasn't expecting anything
from you anyway.
Th-That's just as bad!

<CLT=cltMIND>If it isn't in Rantaro's room, then
where is his <CLT=cltSTRONG>Survivor Perk<CLT=cltMIND>?

<CLT=cltMIND>We didn't find anything on his body.
Did he hide it somewhere before he died?

<CLT=cltMIND>But...hiding it in your room would
be the safest place for it...
<CLT=cltMIND>Did someone...take it?
...Shuichi, what's wrong?

Hey, we're going to check what's behind the
hidden door, right? Let's hurry and do it.
Y-Yeah, you're right.

<CLT=cltMIND>The hidden door is where Rantaro was
investigating just before he died...

<CLT=cltMIND>There might be something in there
that would be a valuable clue.
<CLT=cltMIND>First, I should inspect the hidden door.

You've got guts to label me, the legendary mage,
useless!
I wish you'd use your magic to be useful.
Nyeeeh!?

Stop it, Maki! We already know Himiko
has no use!
Hey! How dare you say I have no boobs!

What? That's not what I said at all. It's plain
to see you're bothered by your chest...
I-I'm not bothered at all!

I just misheard you cuz Shuichi's taking his
sweet time! Hurry up and check the hidden door!
<CLT=cltMIND>What? Why is it *my* fault?
Quit wasting time and check the hidden door!

L-Let's go! I'll repel the mastermind 
with my magic!

Hey, Maki, what was in all those blueprints
you were looking through?

I found a design that worried me a little.
It was drawn with *too* much detail...

It looks like...a vacuum.
What a peculiar shape...

It's a machine that sucks up bugs called
the Bugvac.
A "Bugvac"?

Kokichi came up with the design? But, I thought
there weren't any bugs outside of Gonta's lab.
Now that you mention it...
Oh... That cuz of tiny bugs.

Bugs...? I thought vermin were nowhere to be
seen in this academy.
Yeah, Gonta think that before, but...

When out walking in courtyard, Gonta think
he see tiny bug.

But...bug so tiny, even Gonta no could see it.
And Gonta have 20/0.625 eyesight.

So maybe Gonta just make mistake.
But Gonta think...
No, maybe Gonta just see things...
Gonta *was* always seeing <CLT=cltSTRONG>small bugs<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
But Gonta said he was just seeing things...

Maybe Kokichi asked Miu to invent that
to see for himself.
So Miu actually made this?

After I found this design, I went to Miu's
research lab...

...and I found a prototype that she was
still working on.

This is it. It may be a prototype but it seems
to be functional already.
The suction function is already finished.

<CLT=cltMIND>As she said that, Maki flipped
the switch on the machine, and...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*vrrrooommm!*
It has pretty strong suction...

With this, you can vacuum up all the bugs
around you at once.
Hm... Nothing in it.

Yeah. It looks like it was used several times,
but it doesn't seem like they caught any.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki sighed and turned off
the bug catcher.

Then does that mean there are no bugs?
It was just Gonta's imagination after all?
That's probably the case...

Well, even if there were bugs, I don't know
how that would be a clue...

But I wanted to tell you. Especially since I
spent a lot of time investigating it.
Right, thank you...

<CLT=cltMIND>Were those bugs really just
Gonta's imagination?
<CLT=cltMIND>There must be more to it than that...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Bugvac<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
Y-You guys were here!?

Nyeeeh! If we were all gonna meet up,
why didn't anyone tell me!?

I couldn't find anyone, so I was starting 
to get worried!
Ah, sorry...
...And where were you up until now?

You went to Rantaro's room, right?
Did you find anything interesting?
<CLT=cltMIND>What is *this* expression...?

There wasn't anything else besides the
Bugvac machine.
It was just...a bunch of junk.

They were drawings of weapons and huge
robots that kids would fantasize about.

Some of the other drawing designs were
machines for pulling pranks on people.

Let's hurry and check out the hidden door.
There isn't much time until dawn.

...You don't have to tell me. I'm not going to
kill... I'm just going to get revenge.

It's weird... Sometimes you're just like him,
you know?
It still seems safe here.

It's underground, so it won't be 
destroyed that easily...right?

But I'm worried that if the building collapses,
it's going to cause an avalanche of books.

Dying from being buried in books...
That wouldn't be a bad way to die.
Though, I don't want it to happen now.

Umm...did Gonta's research lab 
get destroyed, too?

Judging by what's happened,
that could be the case...
So it's possible...

That the bugs we saw during the "Insect Meet
and Greet" are loose in the school now...?
Perhaps...

D-Don't worry, it's okay! We didn't catch
anything in the Bugvac, right?
Ah, you're right! Yeah, it's okay!
Ah, what a relief...

I know now's not the time to be worried about
bugs, but...I'm still pretty mentally scarred...

Hey, we're going to check what's behind the
hidden door, right? Let's hurry and do it.

With Keebo's attack just now, the mastermind
was defeated! We win! Part 3 is over!

We shouldn't count on things ending
that easily...

<CLT=cltMIND>There are still a lot of things to investigate,
I can't turn back now!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>There are so many things to investigate...
I don't have time to be distracted by this.

<CLT=cltMIND>A hidden door is revealed when the
bookcase swings open...

<CLT=cltMIND>This door has been locked
this entire time.

<CLT=cltMIND>With Keebo's help, we might be
able to open it.

The door that can only be opened with a
card key... There must be something here.

Maybe...the mastermind is hiding behind
this hidden door?

Then, if we kill them...we can end this
killing game...

No, I told you, we can't kill them.
If you do that, we'd be the same—
Kyaaaaaahhh!!!
Huh!?
Found you!

You guys have been doin' whatever
you feel like, huh?

You can't just go anywhere you want without
permission! Father'll get mad!

I don't like it when Father gets mad!
So before he finds out about this...
I'm gonna destroy you all!
Dammit! Everyone, run!
Wahhhh! I can't move!
Just stay put...for now.

Keebo, you saved us! As a reward, I'll use 
my magic to turn you into a real boy—
So you need me to open that door, right?
Y-Yes please...

Are you ignoring me!? Well, I guess there's 
nothing I can do since I need to charge my—

...Please stand back. It's dangerous to be
too close.

<CLT=cltMIND>After that terse comment, Keebo
aimed his rocket launcher at the door.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should ask Maki
about the blueprints first...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why is Himiko making that face?
I should ask her about it...

<CLT=cltMIND>What did Maki find?
I should ask her for the details.
